accepted.development: Solo side project in small chunks, with long pauses; programming and configuration are comfortable; avoid art/model/map creation.
accepted.audience: Java vanilla client with required resource pack; aim to stay on latest versions; about 15 concurrent players at release.
accepted.core: Factions, blasters, KOTH and Jabba dungeon were successful previously. Lightsabers and armor are core. Force powers are deferred.
accepted.worldRules: Only main survival world is buildable. Other planets can be resource or dungeon destinations. Remove selected vanilla features including villages, potions and elytra; exact disable list pending.
accepted.pvp: Enabled broadly outside safe areas such as spawnpoints. Death drops all carried items including armor and weapons.
accepted.raids: Offline bases may be vulnerable if warpoints are depleted. No TNT cannons. Grenade/explosive breach rules and warpoint mechanics undecided.
accepted.maps: Original Jabba/KOTH maps and mob/plugin configurations remain on a server the user can pull up.
accepted.assets: User has models, sounds, menus, armor, mobs and item assets; repository archive inspected.
accepted.developmentApproach: Clean laptop-hosted development server, selective recovery from older attempts, feature branches integrated into main after satisfaction. Gameplay plugin boundaries first; voting and chat presentation deferred.
accepted.pluginOwnership: Accepted the proposed public/custom division; plugins may be replaced later when beneficial.
accepted.designMethod: Player experience first, feature ordering second, then parameterized Java systems and configured content.
accepted.firstSession: New players arrive in the existing SpawnWorld map, receive a short tutorial (format undecided), then go to survival to establish a base.
accepted.deathRecovery: Death loses carried equipment. Players can return to their faction home and re-equip from stored supplies; respawn location and travel are undecided.
accepted.firstFriendsPlaytest: The discussed gameplay systems should work together in a rough integrated version. Small development slices lead toward this target; content depth remains undecided. Force powers remain deferred.

nextAction: Decide survival arrival, solo faction and claiming requirements, and respawn behavior.
